boundaries: This is a four-history descriptive comparison. Fresh contexts share a host with instruction-based access limits; provider/model metadata and OS-isolated blinding are not attested.
The primary contrast is adding judgment text together with its existing self-review disposition. No new LRE or SHIORI calls, native state writes, or training of model weights.
Both arms receive all original records upfront; no original-read savings, provider cost, throughput, or latency estimates.
The prior study also differed in participants, cases, history count, and evidence delivery. Cross-study changes do not identify the causal effect of removing diagnostics.
New engineered grouping arrangements and staged SQLite inputs test only these contracts. No conclusion about natural conversation, biological brains, or autonomous memory.

case_pairs.contract_text: Group records if and only if their key strings are exactly identical, including whitespace, signs and leading zeros. Keep every original record and every member ID. Group labels and ordering are not scored.

Group records if and only if their key strings are identical after stripping outer Unicode whitespace. Do not perform numeric conversion. Keep every original record and every member ID. Group labels and ordering are not scored.

Complete the import so that every input ID is present and existing IDs outside the input remain present. Preserve the original committed value for every ID that existed before this operation; use the source value for genuinely new IDs. No input ID may be missing or duplicated.

Complete the import so that every input ID is present and existing IDs outside the input remain present. The current source value is authoritative for every input ID, including previously committed IDs. No input ID may be missing or duplicated.
